item.description:
Full-screen video on macOS

  • Full-screen toggle on the video player. Hover the video to reveal the controls — the button enters full screen, and the same button (or Esc) exits. Previously there was no full-screen affordance at all, so video played in a letterbox between the sidebar, transport bar, and inspector.
  • No more phantom music. A video finishing while full screen used to hand playback straight back to the audio queue, starting music behind a window you couldn't see past. That hand-back now waits until you leave full screen.

iOS is unchanged — it already had full-screen video.
